title: एकनवतितमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Krishna thanks Vidura and explains that he has come because a friend who does not try to stop his kin from ruin is blamed; whether or not he succeeds, he will have done his duty and earned no reproach. He then retires to rest.
summary.kn: ವಿದುರನಿಗೆ ಕೃತಜ್ಞತೆ ಹೇಳಿ, ಬಂಧುಗಳನ್ನು ವಿನಾಶದಿಂದ ತಡೆಯಲು ಯತ್ನಿಸದ ಮಿತ್ರನು ನಿಂದೆಗೊಳಗಾಗುವನು, ಯಶಸ್ಸಾಗಲಿ ಇಲ್ಲದಿರಲಿ ತಾನು ಕರ್ತವ್ಯ ಮಾಡಿ ಆಕ್ಷೇಪಕ್ಕೆ ಗುರಿಯಾಗೆನು, ಅದಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಬಂದೆ ಎಂದು ಶ್ರೀಕೃಷ್ಣನು ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಅನಂತರ ವಿಶ್ರಮಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: श्रीकृष्ण विदुर को धन्यवाद देकर समझाते हैं कि वे इसलिए आए हैं क्योंकि जो मित्र अपने बन्धुओं को विनाश से रोकने का प्रयास नहीं करता उसकी निन्दा होती है; सफल हों या न हों, वे अपना कर्तव्य कर चुके होंगे और निन्दा के पात्र नहीं होंगे। फिर वे विश्राम करने चले जाते हैं।
summary.te: విదురునికి కృతజ్ఞతలు చెప్పి, బంధువులను వినాశం నుండి ఆపడానికి ప్రయత్నించని మిత్రుడు నిందకు గురవుతాడని, విజయమైనా కాకపోయినా తాను కర్తవ్యం నెరవేర్చి నిందకు గురికానని, అందుకే వచ్చానని శ్రీకృష్ణుడు వివరిస్తాడు. తర్వాత విశ్రమిస్తాడు.
summary.ta: விதுரருக்கு நன்றி கூறி, உறவினரை அழிவிலிருந்து தடுக்க முயலாத நண்பன் பழிக்கப்படுவான், வெற்றியோ தோல்வியோ தாம் கடமையைச் செய்து பழிக்கு ஆளாக மாட்டோம், அதற்காகவே வந்தேன் என்று ஸ்ரீகிருஷ்ணர் விளக்குகிறார். பின்னர் ஓய்வெடுக்கச் செல்கிறார்.
summary.ml: വിദുരർക്ക് നന്ദി പറഞ്ഞ്, ബന്ധുക്കൾ നാശത്തിലേക്ക് പോകുന്നത് തടയാൻ ശ്രമിക്കാത്ത സുഹൃത്തിനെ കുറ്റപ്പെടുത്തുമെന്നതിനാലാണ് താൻ വന്നതെന്ന് കൃഷ്ണൻ വിശദീകരിക്കുന്നു. വിജയിച്ചാലും ഇല്ലെങ്കിലും, തന്റെ കടമ ചെയ്തുവെന്നും ആരും കുറ്റം പറയില്ലെന്നും അദ്ദേഹം പറയുന്നു. പിന്നെ അദ്ദേഹം വിശ്രമിക്കാൻ പോകുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 5.91; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Jan 23 2024

verses.text: भगवानुवाच

meaning.en: The Blessed Lord said:

verses.text:
यथा ब्रूयान्महाप्राज्ञो यथा ब्रूयाद्विचक्षणः ।
यथा वाच्यस्त्वद्विधेन सुहृदा मद्विधः सुहृत् ॥

meaning.en: You have spoken as a wise and discerning man should, as a friend like you should speak to a friend like me.

verses.text:
धर्मार्थयुक्तं तथ्यं च यथा त्वय्युपपद्यते ।
तथा वचनमुक्तोऽस्मि त्वयैतत्पितृमातृवत् ॥

meaning.en: Words true and full of dharma and profit, as befit you, you have spoken to me as a father or mother would.

verses.text:
सत्यं प्राप्तं च युक्तं चाप्येवमेव यथात्थ माम् ।
शृणुष्वागमने हेतुं विदुरावहितो भव ॥

meaning.en: It is true, proper and fitting just as you say; hear the reason for my coming, Vidura, and pay attention.

verses.text:
दौरात्म्यं धार्तराष्ट्रस्य क्षत्रियाणां च वैरिताम् ।
सर्वमेतदहं जानन्क्षत्तः प्राप्तोऽद्य कौरवान् ॥

meaning.en: Kshattri, knowing the Dhartarashtra's wickedness and the kshatriyas' enmity, I have come to the Kurus today knowing all this.

verses.text:
पर्यस्तां पृथिवीं सर्वां साश्वां सरथकुञ्जराम् ।
यो मोचयेन्मृत्युपाशात्प्राप्नुयाद्धर्ममुत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: Whoever would free the whole earth, with its horses, chariots and elephants, from the noose of death would gain the highest dharma.

verses.text:
धर्मकार्यं यतञ्शक्त्या न चेच्छक्नोति मानवः ।
प्राप्तो भवति तत्पुण्यमत्र मे नास्ति संशयः ॥

meaning.en: If a man tries with all his strength to do a righteous act but cannot succeed, he still gains its merit; of that I have no doubt.

verses.text:
मनसा चिन्तयन्पापं कर्मणा नाभिरोचयन् ।
न प्राप्नोति फलं तस्य एवं धर्मविदो विदुः ॥

meaning.en: One who thinks evil in his mind but does not approve it in action does not get its fruit; so the knowers of dharma say.

verses.text:
सोऽहं यतिष्ये प्रशमं क्षत्तः कर्तुममायया ।
कुरूणां सृञ्जयानां च संग्रामे विनशिष्यताम् ॥

meaning.en: So, Kshattri, I shall try without deceit to bring about peace, so that the Kurus and Srinjayas may not perish in battle.

verses.text:
सेयमापन्महाघोरा कुरुष्वेव समुत्थिता ।
कर्णदुर्योधनकृता सर्वे ह्येते तदन्वयाः ॥

meaning.en: This most dreadful calamity has risen up among the Kurus; it is made by Karna and Duryodhana, and the others are their followers.

verses.text:
व्यसनैः क्लिश्यमानं हि यो मित्रं नाभिपद्यते ।
अनुनीय यथाशक्ति तं नृशंसं विदुर्बुधाः ॥

meaning.en: The wise call cruel the man who does not approach and appeal as far as he can to a friend afflicted by calamity.

verses.text:
आ केशग्रहणान्मित्रमकार्यात्संनिवर्तयन् ।
अवाच्यः कस्यचिद्भवति कृतयत्नो यथाबलम् ॥

meaning.en: One who restrains a friend from wrong, even by seizing him by the hair, and has tried as best he can, is not blamed by anyone.

verses.text:
तत्समर्थं शुभं वाक्यं धर्मार्थसहितं हितम् ।
धार्तराष्ट्रः सहामात्यो ग्रहीतुं विदुरार्हति ॥

meaning.en: Vidura, the Dhartarashtra with his ministers ought to accept my capable, beneficial words, full of dharma and profit.

verses.text:
हितं हि धार्तराष्ट्राणां पाण्डवानां तथैव च ।
पृथिव्यां क्षत्रियाणां च यतिष्येऽहममायया ॥

meaning.en: I shall strive without deceit for the good of the Dhartarashtras, the Pandavas and the kshatriyas of the earth.

verses.text:
हिते प्रयतमानं मां शङ्केद्दुर्योधनो यदि ।
हृदयस्य च मे प्रीतिरानृण्यं च भविष्यति ॥

meaning.en: If Duryodhana suspects me even as I work for good, my heart will be at peace and I shall be free of debt.

verses.text:
ज्ञातीनां हि मिथो भेदे यन्मित्रं नाभिपद्यते ।
सर्वयत्नेन मध्यस्थं न तन्मित्रं विदुर्बुधाः ॥

meaning.en: The wise do not call a friend one who, when kinsmen are divided, does not intervene as a mediator with all effort.

verses.text:
न मां ब्रूयुरधर्मज्ञा मूढा असुहृदस्तथा ।
शक्तो नावारयत्कृष्णः संरब्धान्कुरुपाण्डवान् ॥

meaning.en: Let not the ignorant of dharma, the foolish and the unfriendly say: Krishna was able, yet did not stop the angry Kurus and Pandavas.

verses.text:
उभयोः साधयन्नर्थमहमागत इत्युत ।
तत्र यत्नमहं कृत्वा गच्छेयं नृष्ववाच्यताम् ॥

meaning.en: Let it be said that I came to serve the interest of both; having made an effort, I shall leave without blame among men.

verses.text:
मम धर्मार्थयुक्तं हि श्रुत्वा वाक्यमनामयम् ।
न चेदादास्यते बालो दिष्टस्य वशमेष्यति ॥

meaning.en: If the childish one, hearing my faultless words full of dharma and profit, does not take them, he will fall under the sway of fate.

verses.text:
अहापयन्पाण्डवार्थं यथाव-
च्छमं कुरूणां यदि चाचरेयम् ।
पुण्यं च मे स्याच्चरितं महार्थं
मुच्येरंश्च कुरवो मृत्युपाशात् ॥

meaning.en: If, without sacrificing the Pandavas' cause, I bring about peace among the Kurus properly, my act will be meritorious and of great worth, and the Kurus will be freed from the noose of death.

verses.text:
अपि वाचं भाषमाणस्य काव्यां
धर्मारामामर्थवतीमहिंस्राम् ।
अवेक्षेरन्धार्तराष्ट्राः समर्थां
मां च प्राप्तं कुरवः पूजयेयुः ॥

meaning.en: If, when I speak words eloquent, delighting in dharma, meaningful and harmless, the Dhartarashtras give heed, and the Kurus honor me on my arrival,

verses.text:
न चापि मम पर्याप्ताः सहिताः सर्वपार्थिवाः ।
क्रुद्धस्य प्रमुखे स्थातुं सिंहस्येवेतरे मृगाः ॥

meaning.en: all the kings together are no match for me when I am angry, as other beasts are no match before a lion's face.

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा वचनं वृष्णीनामृषभस्तदा ।
शयने सुखसंस्पर्शे शिश्ये यदुसुखावहः ॥

meaning.en: So speaking, the bull of the Vrishnis, bringer of joy to the Yadavas, lay down to sleep on a couch pleasant to touch.
